source.description: A reviewed six-panel raster contact sheet showing one consistent birthday-cake slice progressing from pale construction to bold felt-tip outlines and a raspberry, lavender, mint, and tangerine marker palette.
source.notes: Honest 2026-05-12 archive lesson. Keep one three-quarter triangular cake slice with three sponge layers, two filling bands, one top frosting layer with a single front drip, one striped candle with two tangerine diagonal bands, one flame, exactly six sprinkle marks, two side highlight reserves, one top frosting paper highlight, and one shallow shadow stable. No face, plate, whole cake, gift, party scene, text, sticker border, badge frame, signature, watermark, or final-only feature.

process_strategy: Lock the cake prism, layer divisions, candle footprint, flame, sprinkles, and shadow before outlining; establish every layer and decoration before inking; then color only the existing shapes so the final remains a cumulative face-free marker drawing in a palette distinct from the current soda can.

final_elements.description: Countable horizontal cake layers and one soft frosting edge make the slice readable before decoration or color.

final_elements.name: one candle, two tangerine bands, one flame, six sprinkles, two side highlight reserves, and shallow shadow
final_elements.description: A single upright candle and six countable top decorations sit in reserved areas without covering finished cake detail.

final_elements.description: Imperfect felt-tip outlines and a cool-fruit palette clarify every established shape while preserving visible streaks, the two side highlights, and one top frosting paper highlight.

rejection_checks: The same three-quarter wedge, crop, scale, plane angles, candle position, layer heights, and shadow must persist through all six panels.

Exactly three sponge layers, two filling bands, one frosting drip, one candle, two tangerine bands, one flame, six sprinkles, two side highlights, and one top frosting highlight must appear before the final panel and persist.
No face, plate, whole cake, gift, balloons, confetti, words, numbers, extra candle, sticker outline, badge frame, signature, watermark, or final-only motif may appear.
The finish must retain visible felt-tip texture and handmade edge variation rather than polished vector or bakery-ad gloss, and no adjacent frame may look unchanged at card size.
